bootstrap.scheme: cluster: 18 (seed,fold) runs w/ repl., then 8 held-out contexts w/ repl. within each drawn run; same draws for all C and all quantities

crossing_rule: first upward crossing (g_{j-1} <= 0 < g_j), linear in ln C; g(6) > 0 -> <= 6; never > 0 -> > 40 (censored)

H2a_registered_quantity.quantity: mse_gain = resid_mse_nocontext (analytic zero residual) - resid_mse_context, frozen protocol
H2a_registered_quantity.confound: under the frozen selection the context network can never select the zero-residual step-0 model, while the comparator IS the zero residual; part of any negative gain is the cost of a forced non-zero residual, not of the context pathway (A1). Reported, not used for H2a.

H2b_note: C*_emp for H2b = primary cstar_emp above; if censored (> 40) H2b is "untestable (censored)" per A1. H2b verdict is NOT computed here (blinded).

seed0_existing.note: original 2026-09-20 run, seed 0, evenly spaced subsets, C in {6,12,24,40} only, context arm only (no ablation) -> registered quantity only; unweighted mean over held-out contexts per fold, then over 6 folds. NOT pooled into the confirmatory CIs.
